prompt: Which Greek pole vaulter who participated in the 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo also won gold at the 2015 IAAF Diamond League?
answer: Nikoleta (Nikol) Kyriakopoulou. She placed eighth in women’s pole vault at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics and won the 2015 IAAF Diamond League title.
